project_type: Vite + React 19 + TypeScript PWA (WFRP 4e character sheet); client-only, no backend
build_system: Vite 8 + tsc project references (tsc --build). TS is aliased: `typescript` -> @typescript/typescript6 for eslint's parser, `@typescript/native` -> real typescript@7.0.2 for the tsc binary (see package.json note). Base path is '/PWACharSheet/'. Node >= 20 required (engines.node).
test_framework: Vitest 5 + @testing-library/react + fast-check 4; environment jsdom, globals true, setupFiles ./src/test-setup.ts, testTimeout 15000. fake-indexeddb available for IndexedDB in tests.
verification_instructions: Run ALL of these from d:\Git\PWACharSheet and require every one clean before the feature is done: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit`; `npm run build`; `vitest --run`; `npx eslint .` (0 errors, no new warnings). No existing test may be modified. No new @ts-ignore / eslint-disable; the single sanctioned `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` pattern mirroring src/components/shared/Tooltip.tsx may be reused ONLY if a setState-in-effect is genuinely needed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: vite build regenerates the service worker (sw.js) via src/build/vite-plugin-sw-precache; no checked-in generated source files to hand-produce. null otherwise.
environment_constraints: CompressionStream/DecompressionStream are Node globals (>=20), NOT provided by jsdom itself; the gzip test must open with `expect(typeof CompressionStream).toBe('function')` and the same for DecompressionStream to fail loudly. App-side feature-detect `typeof CompressionStream === 'undefined'` disables the share-link action; the snapshot path never needs it.
contribution_requirements: Workspace steering rules apply: (1) rules-compliance — reuse the existing calculators (src/logic/*), never reinvent stat math; cite the WFRP4e Core page in comments for any presented derived stat (wounds: calculators.ts calculateWoundsCore; AP: Core p.293; max enc: Core p.293/p.146; movement: Core p.164 Walk=2xM/Run=4xM); never invent mechanics. (2) calculated-total-tooltips — every calculated total shown must have a breakdown tooltip via Tooltip + TooltipTriggerCell reusing the *BreakdownContent components. (3) fix-errors — fix surfaced errors at root cause, no suppressions. Feature is additive; existing tests stay green.
key_patterns: Hash routing is pure (src/logic/hash-route.ts parseHash/formatHash + src/hooks/useHashRoute.ts); the view route is handled SEPARATELY by new src/logic/view-route.ts + src/hooks/useViewRoute.ts, intercepted in AppContent BEFORE the welcome/shell branch, and in App() before startup migration. Single-character serialization already exists: exportToJSONWithPortrait(character, characterId) and importFromJSON(json)/importFromJSONWithPortrait(json) in src/storage/export-import.ts with CURRENT_VERSION=8; importFromJSON only guarantees the 4 required keys and the numeric _v ceiling, then deepMergeImport onto BLANK_CHARACTER (copies arrays/primitives verbatim — so present-but-wrong-typed fields survive and must be normalized by share-validate). Derived totals are produced inline in useCharacter (hardyLevel, woundMultiplier from SPECIES_DATA, species-corrected woundsUseSB, strongBack/sturdy levels, SB=getBonus(S), rangedDamageSBMode) — these are extracted VERBATIM into the new pure deriveSheetTotals(character) in src/logic/sheet-totals.ts, consumed by useCharacter, the viewer, and the stat block (the AC2 reuse contract). useCharacter's returned armourPoints memo re-keys APResult (head/leftArm/rightArm/body/leftLeg/rightLeg/shield) to the sheet ArmourPoints shape (head/lArm/rArm/body/lLeg/rLeg/shield); deriveSheetTotals re-keys identically. Breakdown tooltips: Tooltip.tsx + TooltipTriggerCell.tsx (role=button div, hover+keyboard/tap, one tooltip open at a time) + *BreakdownContent.tsx under src/components/pages/. PrintLayout.tsx has a module-private shouldRenderSection(character, key) + SectionKey union — extract verbatim into src/logic/section-visibility.ts and import from both PrintLayout and the viewer. Settings (src/components/pages/SettingsPage.tsx) already receives characterId as a prop and hosts Export/Import/Backup/Restore cards with established clipboard/download patterns (handleExportClipboard/handleExportFile use exportToJSONWithPortrait + safeName+timestamp).
directory_structure: src/logic/ = pure calculators/helpers + their __tests__; src/hooks/ = React hooks; src/storage/ = localStorage/IndexedDB serialization; src/components/pages/ = page components incl. *BreakdownContent.tsx; src/components/shared/ = reusable UI (Tooltip, TooltipTriggerCell, ConfirmDialog, viewer); src/components/layout/ = Navigation/PrintLayout/etc; src/types/character.ts = Character type + BLANK_CHARACTER + CHARACTERISTIC_KEYS; src/__tests__/ = app-level tests; docs/ = authoritative WFRP4e rulebooks.
